expectations.evidence: No tailwind.config.js created. Uses CSS-first @variant dark configuration in styles.css.
Uses @variant dark (&:where(.dark, .dark *)) in styles.css. Templates use dark: prefix classes throughout.
ThemeService uses window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)') for initial value and watchOsPreference() with addEventListener('change') for live updates.
DarkModeToggleComponent with toggle() method that cycles light/dark. Uses inject(ThemeService).
ThemeService uses signal<ColorScheme>('light') for _scheme, computed() for isDark. Toggle component uses computed() for isDark and ariaLabel.
